name: Woppy – AI Facebook & Instagram Auto Post for WooCommerce
author: garganoadv

sections.description:
Woppy turns your WooCommerce products into ready-to-publish Facebook and Instagram posts. Pick a product, let AI write the caption, hashtags and call to action, and publish it to your Facebook Page straight from your WordPress dashboard.

No copy-pasting product details, no switching between tabs, no writer’s block. Your store stays the single source of truth: Woppy reads the product title, description, price, image and link, and builds a social post around them.

Why store owners use Woppy

  • WooCommerce to Facebook auto post – publish any product to your Facebook Page in a couple of clicks
  • AI caption generator for products – persuasive text, hashtags and CTA written for each product
  • Your brand voice – choose tone and audience, and edit every post before it goes live
  • Works inside WordPress – no external dashboard to learn, no API keys to configure
  • Free plan included – up to 10 AI-generated posts per month

How it works

  1. Connect your Facebook Page from Woppy → Social Connections
  2. Select one or more WooCommerce products
  3. Choose tone and audience, then click Generate Text
  4. Review the AI post, edit it if you like, and click Publish Immediately

Your product is now a live social media post, with image and link back to your store.

Who it is for

  • Small WooCommerce shops that want an active Facebook and Instagram presence without a social media manager
  • Agencies and freelancers who manage social media marketing for several e-commerce clients
  • Store owners who launch new products often and want them promoted the same day

Premium features

Need more automation? Premium plans (available at woppy.io) add:

  • AI image generation – promotional images created from your product photo
  • Post scheduling and content calendar – plan a week or a month of social posts in advance
  • Instagram auto post – publish to Instagram Business accounts connected to your Facebook Pages
  • Multiple pages and users – unlimited Facebook and Instagram pages, up to 3 WordPress users

Free Usage

The Woppy service offers a free usage tier including:

• Up to 10 AI-generated posts per month
• Full access to core publishing features
• No API keys required

Usage limits are managed server-side by the Woppy service.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality.

1) Woppy Service (api.woppy.io)

Purpose: Generates AI content and publishes posts to connected social accounts.
Data sent:
– Site URL
– WordPress user ID
– Selected product data (title, description, price, image URL)
– Site language (locale) and selected tone of voice
– Page/account identifiers
– Post content
When:
– During content generation
– When retrieving page data
– When publishing posts
– When retrieving usage quota
Provider: Woppy (Gargano Adv)
Terms: https://woppy.io/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://woppy.io/privacy-policy/
AI processing: to generate texts and images, the Woppy service sends the selected product data and settings to OpenAI (https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/, https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/). The plugin never connects to OpenAI directly.

2) Woppy Auth (auth.woppy.io)

Purpose: Handles Facebook OAuth authentication.
Data sent:
– Site URL
– WordPress user ID
– OAuth parameters (redirect URL, state, nonce)
When:
– When connecting a Facebook account
Provider: Woppy (Gargano Adv)
Terms: https://woppy.io/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://woppy.io/privacy-policy/

3) Facebook / Meta Platforms

Purpose: Authentication and post publishing.
Data sent:
– OAuth tokens
– Post content
– Product information when publishing
Terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy

Support

Documentation: https://woppy.io/docs
Support: https://woppy.io/support
Website: https://woppy.io
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for Woppy
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin

After activation:

  1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  2. Go to Woppy → Social Connections
  3. Connect your Facebook account
  4. Start generating posts
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys or an OpenAI account?

No. Woppy works without entering any API key: AI generation runs on the Woppy service and the free plan is active as soon as you install the plugin.

Is Woppy free?

Yes. The free plan includes up to 10 AI-generated posts per month and publishing to one Facebook Page. Premium plans add scheduling, AI images, Instagram and multiple pages.

Can I auto post WooCommerce products to Instagram?

Instagram publishing is available with Premium, for Instagram Business accounts linked to your Facebook Pages.

Can I edit the AI text before publishing?

Yes. Every generated post is shown as a preview and can be edited or regenerated before you publish it.

In which languages does the AI write?

Posts are written in the language of your WordPress site, and you can choose the tone of voice in the settings. The plugin interface is available in English, Italian, German and French.

Is scheduling included in the free version?

No. Scheduling and the content calendar are Premium features.

Can I connect multiple pages?

The free version supports one Facebook Page. Premium supports unlimited Facebook and Instagram pages and up to 3 users.

Does Woppy slow down my store?

No. Woppy only runs in the WordPress admin when you generate or publish posts. Nothing is loaded on your storefront.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • New: optional review reminder after your first published post (can be snoozed or dismissed)
  • Fix: removed legacy OAuth callback code that could cause a fatal error on PHP 8
  • Improved: clear error message when the AI service is temporarily unavailable
  • Fix: with an active Premium license, the image description box and the “Schedule” button work again
  • Fix: admin notices (Facebook connection result) and the “Test connection” button now work correctly
  • Improved: plugin description, FAQ and tags
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2

1.0.10

  • Fixed Instagram publishing via Premium filter
  • Updated WordPress compatibility to 7.0.3

1.0.3

  • Updated plugin name to Woppy – AI Social Posts for WooCommerce

1.0.2

  • Updated plugin name and branding
  • Added Premium feature section
  • Improved marketing-focused description

1.0.1

  • Improved quota display
  • Enhanced internationalization support

1.0.0

  • Initial release
